items.text: The video game Grand Theft Auto VI achieves US$3.79 billion in sales on its launch day, more than any other entertainment product in history.
The space probe Voyager 1 (rendering shown) becomes the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth.
In Canadian football, the Edmonton Elks defeat the Montreal Alouettes to win the Grey Cup.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amidst allegations of being targeted by a Chinese spy and of having extramarital affairs.
